gloss: quick and easy, the fastest way

definitions.gloss: quick and easy, the fastest way, expedient
definitions.explanation: Describes a method or approach that is the quickest and simplest way to achieve something. Often implies cutting through complexity to get straight to the point.

examples.japanese: {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧な。
examples.english: Isn't there a quicker way to do this?

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}する→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧{手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い。

⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い。
examples.english: Rather than looking it up yourself, it's quicker to ask someone who knows.

notes:
{手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い is a colloquial expression meaning the quickest, most efficient way to do something. It is commonly used in spoken Japanese when suggesting shortcuts or practical solutions.

ETYMOLOGY: Literally "quick at taking by hand" — the image is of grabbing something swiftly without fuss.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い: doing ~ is the quickest way
- {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}く + verb: to quickly ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}い⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: the quickest method
- {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}く⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: to put it simply, in short
- {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}く⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to get it done quickly

NOTE: The adverbial form {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}く is very common, especially in the phrase {手|て}っ{取|と}り{早|はや}く⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ ("to put it briefly").
